name: Kiridera Mei
source:
A student at Ribun 6 Academy and the leader of Ψcliminal. Extreme rationalist and merciless. Controls people and will not hesitate to kill.

[Spoiler]Kiridera's birth name is "Maina Mei." He is the twin brother of Myuu, and the younger brother of Narumi. He and Myuu are naturally-born Ψ-users, and turn 18 during the events of the story.[/spoiler]
